SELECT platform,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(price)::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM orders
GROUP BY platform
ORDER BY revenue DESC
订单量最高的 10 个 SKU

SELECT sku,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(price)::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM orders
GROUP BY sku
ORDER BY orders DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT province,
       COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE province IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY province
ORDER BY orders DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(price)::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM orders
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

SELECT platform,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(AVG(price)::numeric, 2) AS average_spend
FROM orders
GROUP BY platform
ORDER BY orders DESC

SELECT filename, platform, inserted_orders,
       duplicate_rows, invalid_rows, uploaded_at
FROM upload_batches
ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC
LIMIT 20
